other_failure_modes.name: Mean-centering difference features before anti-symmetric augmentation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies StandardScaler (which centers by mean) to the difference features before augmenting the data with swapped pairs. Since the empirical mean of the differences is not exactly zero, `-xDiff_tr` is not equivalent to scaling the negated difference `-(x_A - x_B)`. This breaks the strict mathematical anti-symmetry of the Siamese network. The scaler should either be fitted without mean centering (`with_mean=False`), or fitted on the augmented symmetric dataset.
